title: Rappa Pal
style: Cuban dembow-trap with clapping percussion, syncopated clave bounce, and trap bass sliding under bright plucks; verse rides sparse handclaps and talk-rap rhythm, pre-chorus lifts with stacked shout doubles, chorus hits with gang chants and a sticky call-and-response hook. High female vocals skim the top, ad-lib panned responses, quick delay throws on brand phrases, reverse swells into each drop, crisp punchy mix with glossy low-end, rap, latin, alternative r&b
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cuban style, short and hot
Palmas secas, pega el golpe
Yo te miro, tú me sigues
Con el barrio en la frente

rappal.app rap pal dot app
you got that? sing it back pal
rap back wanna dance pal
dance latin america pal

[Pre-Chorus]
Súbelo, súbelo más
Que la cintura no pare
Dime sí, dime ya
Que esta noche se enciende

[Chorus]
rappal.app rap pal dot app
rappal.app rap pal dot app
you got that? sing it back pal
rap back, rap back, pal

go to pal dot dance
be my song pal
song pal dot a i
songpal.ai

[Verse 2]
Clap clap, mano arriba
Tu sonrisa me dispara
Alternative R&B
pero el tumbao no falla

high vocals, niño y trueno
voces que cortan el aire
trap bass bajo la falda
y tu paso me desarma
